items.briefing:
Australian authorities have reached out to more than 10,000 Australians caught up in an international cryptocurrency scam investigation, highlighting how widespread financial scams remain. If you receive contact from the National Anti-Scam Centre, take it seriously and follow their guidance. Separately, a study found only 5% of staff use generative AI tools effectively — a reminder that using AI at work without proper understanding can create risks, including errors or data exposure.

**Practical tip:** If you use AI tools like ChatGPT for work tasks, always review the output carefully — never submit AI-generated content without checking it yourself first.

featured.title: National Anti-Scam Centre contacts more than 10,000 Australians following international cryptocurrency scam investigation - Scamwatch
featured.quote: Over 10,000 Australians targeted in international crypto scam; direct threat to local citizens.
